title: Association of TLR 9 gene polymorphisms with remission in patients with rheumatoid arthritis receiving TNF-alpha inhibitors and development of machine learning models.
authors: Kim, Woorim; Kim, Tae Hyeok; Oh, Soo Jin; Kim, Hyun Jeong; Kim, Joo Hee; Kim, Hyoun-Ah; Jung, Ju-Yang; Choi, In Ah; Lee, Kyung Eun
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨TLR9基因多态性与类风湿关节炎患者对TNF-α抑制剂缓解的关联并构建机器学习预测模型，但对象为基因多态性与临床疗效，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Toll-like receptor (TLR)-4 and TLR9 are known to play important roles in the immune system, and several studies have shown their association with the development of rheumatoid arthritis (RA) and regulation of tumor necrosis factor alpha (TNF-alpha). However, studies that investigate the association between TLR4 or TLR9 gene polymorphisms and remission of the disease in RA patients taking TNF-alpha inhibitors have yet to be conducted. In this context, this study was designed to investigate the effects of polymorphisms in TLR4 and TLR9 on response to TNF-alpha inhibitors and to train various models using machine learning approaches to predict remission. A total of six single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) were investigated. Logistic regression analysis was used to investigate the association between genetic polymorphisms and response to treatment. Various machine learning methods were utilized for prediction of remission. After adjusting for covariates, the rate of remission of T-allele carriers of TLR9 rs352139 was about 5 times that of the CC-genotype carriers (95% confidence interval (CI) 1.325-19.231, p = 0.018). Among machine learning algorithms, multivariate logistic regression and elastic net showed the best prediction with the area under the receiver-operating curve (AUROC) value of 0.71 (95% CI 0.597-0.823 for both models). This study showed an association between a TLR9 polymorphism (rs352139) and treatment response in RA patients receiving TNF-alpha inhibitors. Moreover, this study utilized various machine learning methods for prediction, among which the elastic net provided the best model for remission prediction.
abstract_zh: Toll样受体（Toll-like receptor, TLR）-4和TLR9已知在免疫系统中发挥重要作用，多项研究已表明它们与类风湿关节炎（rheumatoid arthritis, RA）的发生及肿瘤坏死因子α（tumor necrosis factor alpha, TNF-alpha）的调控相关。然而，关于TLR4或TLR9基因多态性与接受TNF-alpha抑制剂治疗的RA患者疾病缓解之间关联的研究尚未开展。在此背景下，本研究旨在探讨TLR4和TLR9多态性对TNF-alpha抑制剂应答的影响，并利用机器学习方法训练多种模型以预测缓解情况。共研究了六个单核苷酸多态性（single nucleotide polymorphisms, SNPs）。采用逻辑回归分析探讨基因多态性与治疗应答之间的关联，并运用多种机器学习方法进行缓解预测。在调整协变量后，TLR9 rs352139 T等位基因携带者的缓解率约为CC基因型携带者的5倍（95%置信区间（confidence interval, CI）1.325-19.231，p = 0.018）。在机器学习算法中，多变量逻辑回归和弹性网络（elastic net）表现出最佳预测性能，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（area under the receiver-operating curve, AUROC）值为0.71（两种模型的95% CI均为0.597-0.823）。本研究显示，接受TNF-alpha抑制剂治疗的RA患者中，TLR9多态性（rs352139）与治疗应答存在关联。此外，本研究利用多种机器学习方法进行预测，其中弹性网络提供了最佳的缓解预测模型。
